  var found='';

    var m=items[i].match(/data-subtitle="([^"]*)"/);
    if(m&&m[1]==title){
      var s=items[i].match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/);
      if(s){found='https://www.yssm5.xyz'+s[1];break}
    }
  }
  if(!found){
    var s0=items[0].match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/);
    if(s0){found='https://www.yssm5.xyz'+s0[1]}
  }
  found;
}
</js>
